I replied to Pree in the thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline because nothing she can see mentions it.

**What I checked:** I looked through the channels Pree belongs to: #central-team, #central-random and #inc-tansley-carrier-api. I also read the shared Central team files. None of them mention Thornbury Cloth Co., an order form for them, or a 23 May deadline. I couldn't tell from anything she can see whether Thornbury is an account we track.

**What I told her:**
- I'm treating the date as unverified and haven't recorded it as a deadline anywhere.
- It's 14 Oct now, so 23 May has already passed this year. If the date is right, it either means May 2027 or it's out of date.
- She should get it confirmed in writing by her Thornbury contact or by whoever owns the account before anyone plans around it.

I didn't use `search_messages` or read anything Pree can't see. No mail or approvals were needed.
